chapters.title: What Azure Open Datasets actually is
Catalog: taxi trips, public safety, COVID-19 and ML benchmarks
Access via Python, Azure ML, Power BI, Synapse and Databricks
The cost question: compute and egress

takeaways: Azure Open Datasets is a free catalog of curated public data, such as NOAA weather, holidays, US Census and NYC taxi trips, that Microsoft cleans, stores in Parquet and keeps refreshed in Azure.

You can load the data with the azureml-opendatasets Python package, register it in Azure Machine Learning, connect Power BI through the Blob Storage connector or query it with Synapse serverless SQL and Databricks.
The data and its storage are free, but compute, egress and your own storage are not, so keep compute in the dataset's region and sample before you scale.
hook: Learning data science but stuck without clean, interesting data to practice on? This episode explains Azure Open Datasets for beginners, analysts and ML learners: what is in the catalog, how to pull it into Python, Azure Machine Learning or Power BI, and what really costs money. You will be able to grab ready-to-use data in minutes without scraping or cleaning.
